**Why a follow-up and not a push to #27324.** PR #27324 is Tier H: it touches one anchor line of ADR-0119. It waits on a governed approval and has a PASS on file at `1a50dca1e`. A push that only carries findings would owe the same reviewer a delta re-review on a new head, and contract-review capacity is short. All three findings are prose. None changes an export, an accept set or a gate.

## Wanted (land after PR #27324)

1. **Review ④.1:** `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts:172-173`, the `strictReadonlyWrites` docblock, still says "crosses the RPC / Virtual Data Engine boundary". With the protocol retired, change the sentence to read as line 61 of the same file now does ("cannot be serialized … REST/wire body").
2. **Review ④.4:** "every arm admitted a caller-supplied `context`" should read "every read and write arm …", in the D3 `reason` of `semantic/18.data-engine-rpc-protocol-retired.ts` and in the changeset (or a follow-up changeset if the pending one has been consumed). `execute` carried an untyped `options` record, and `vectorFind` had no `context`. The decision card's wording was already exact.
3. **Review ③.8:** the row note at `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md:718` (`data-engine.zod.ts`, 16 → 6 sites) should say that ten more sites left with #27028.

**Clause-②:** `no` (prose in a docblock, a D3 `reason` string and an audit ledger). **Metadata-protocol:** `none`. If the D3 `reason` changes, the upgrade guide regenerates.
